scientific_integrity.objects: The dominance complexes of the two strongly regular (16,6,2,2) graphs, plus the full rational automorphism action in the Shrikhande case.
scientific_integrity.priority_limit: No claim of a verified first publication; an unindexed equivalent result remains possible.
scientific_integrity.scope_of_proof: Exact finite face-poset and Morse acyclicity certificates plus discrete-Morse and Lefschetz theorems. The rook result is integral homology, not homotopy splitting.

scientific_limitations: No rook higher attaching maps evaluated.
No uniform theorem for arbitrary strongly regular graphs.
title: Dominance homotopy and symmetry distinguish the Shrikhande–rook twins
